title: Предупреждение для Вики  (A Warning for Vika)

segments.t: After discovering that Aleksandr's stories are all fabrications, Max heads into the dining room to warn Vika that the new head chef is a shameless liar. Vika, however, assumes Max is speaking out of jealousy and coldly tells him to mind his own business.
Вик, мне надо с тобой поговорить.
Let's walk back through the scene line by line.
'We are glad to see you.' Vika brings out the contrast between 'glad' and 'you' in a few short words.
'Good evening.' Kostya anchors the line on 'good', while 'evening' completes the thought. Vika answers right away.
'Right this way. Give it a try.' In Russian, the idea of 'come in' flows naturally into 'try' without extra filler words.
Вик, мне надо с тобой поговорить.
'Vika, I need to talk to you.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'Vika' before landing on 'to talk'.
'Get out of the dining room.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'go' and finishing on 'hall'. Kostya answers right away.
'I wanted to warn you.' Kostya addresses the listener with the informal singular 'you' alongside 'to warn'.
'There is this guy here.' Vika brings out the contrast between 'here' and 'one' in a few short words.
'He is lying.' The meaning hinges on 'he' working together with 'is lying' in spoken Russian. Vika answers right away.
'Are you talking about yourself?' In spoken Russian, the words stay in their normal statement order and Vika's rising voice at the end turns the line into a question.
'And what business is it of yours?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'and' before landing on 'matter'.
'Well, I am worried about you.' In Russian, the idea of 'come on' flows naturally into 'worry' without extra filler words. Kostya answers right away.
'And who are you to me?' Kostya anchors the line on 'and', while 'who' completes the thought.
'None of your business.' The grammar packs 'not' and 'matter' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Let's hear the full exchange one more time at natural speed.
Вик, мне надо с тобой поговорить.
That wraps up this scene as having realized that Aleksandr steals stories and lies to impress women, Max tries to warn Vika in the dining room, but she brushes him off as jealous. See you next time!
